claims.text: ChainPoll achieves an overall AUROC of 0.781 across the RealHall benchmarks.
ChainPoll surpasses the next best theoretical method by 11% on RealHall benchmarks.
ChainPoll exceeds industry standards by over 23% on RealHall benchmarks.
RealHall is a benchmark collection consisting of four challenging datasets for modern LLMs.
Adherence evaluates an LLM's analytical capabilities within given documents and contexts for Retrieval Augmented Generation workflows.
Correctness identifies logical and reasoning errors in LLM outputs.

evidence.description: ChainPoll outperforms in all RealHall benchmarks, achieving an overall AUROC of 0.781.
ChainPoll's performance surpasses the next best theoretical method by 11%.
ChainPoll's performance exceeds industry standards by over 23%.

methodologies.name: ChainPoll
methodologies.description: An LLM hallucination detection method using Adherence and Correctness metrics.

methodologies.name: RealHall
methodologies.description: A refined collection of four benchmark datasets challenging for modern LLMs to assess hallucination detection metrics.

limitations.text: Tasks and datasets from previous hallucination detection studies are not suitable for potent modern LLMs.
